title: Starmap
description: The root of `star-systems.json`: every star system on the starmap.

modVersion.description: The four-part version of the mod that wrote the file; the other files match the catalog written by the same version.

exportedAt.description: When the file was last written, in ISO 8601 with the local time's UTC offset.

trigger.description: What caused the export that last wrote the file.

starSystems.description: Every star system, keyed by the id of its active definition.

ExportTrigger.description: What caused an export. `careerLoaded`: A career is loaded, new or from a save. The game state is skipped while a finished contract's results are still to be applied, and the catalog is rebuilt only when it's missing or stale, once the game has loaded every vehicle, turret and design mask. `manualSave`: The player saves the career outside combat. `autosave`: The game saves the career on its own outside combat, e.g. once an event's popup is closed with the picked option's results applied, or once a contract's results are applied. `contractCompleted`: A contract's results are applied, salvage included, where the game doesn't save the career afterwards, which is `autosave` otherwise. `financialReportShown`: The monthly financial report is shown, with the expenses paid. `mechLabOrderCompleted`: A mech lab order completes, at the end of a day or right away when it has nothing left to do; when several work orders complete together, the last one names the export. `pilotHealed`: A pilot's healing in the med bay completes, as `mechLabOrderCompleted`. `shipUpgradeCompleted`: An Argo upgrade's installation completes, as `mechLabOrderCompleted`. `contractsGenerated`: The game has generated a star system's contracts. `jumped`: The ship has jumped into its destination star system, once the game has refreshed the star system's stores and hiring hall, with its contracts; work orders completing that day export with it. `arrived`: The ship arrives at the planet after a trip. `storeClosed`: A store closes, from the main screen or the mech lab. `purchaseCompleted`: The store screen completes a purchase, or refuses one. `saleCompleted`: The store screen completes a sale, or refuses one, once for a stack sold at once. `mechBayChanged`: The mech bay changes: a refit, repair, readying or storing is queued, an order is cancelled, the work queue is reordered, a mech or chassis is stored or scrapped, a stored component's repair is queued, or a mech is renamed without a refit. `experienceSpent`: The barracks confirm a pilot's training. `mechPlacementShown`: The game asks where to put a new mech because every mech bay is full, e.g. after salvage completes one. `missionCompleted`: A mission ends, still in combat, before the salvage is chosen. `salvageChosen`: The after-action report has finalized the salvage: once the priority salvage is confirmed, or right away when there is nothing to choose. `shipUpgradeStarted`: An Argo upgrade is bought and its installation starts. `phaseStarted`: A phase begins, before its first unit acts: the battle's first once the lance is deployed, and every later one, also one reached by reserving units. `combatStarted`: A new battle begins, when the briefing is dismissed. `combatLoaded`: A battle is loaded from a save, continuing mid-phase. `activationCompleted`: A unit's activation is done, its attacks resolved; out of contact, once the player's units have all moved. Reserving a unit doesn't count.

StarSystem.description: A star system with its active definition and its career state. The story swaps some star systems' definitions (e.g. to change their owner); the id and what the definition holds are the active one's.

id.description: The active definition's id, as in the references to the star system.

name.description: The name, as in the references to the star system.

owner.description: The faction that owns the star system.

tags.description: The star system's tags, sorted, which the events' requirements check, also those its starmap panel doesn't show.

biomes.description: The biomes the star system's missions can be on, sorted by name.

maps.description: The maps the star system's contracts can be fought on, as the contract generator selects them from its biomes and map tags; each map's terrain is in catalog.json mapDefinitions. The contract type and the maps the game offered lately narrow a contract's choice further, which isn't exported.

stores.description: The item collections each of the star system's stores draws its stock from on arrival, every entry of each once, by their ids in catalog.json itemCollectionDefinitions, sorted. A store without any doesn't exist in the star system. The story adds collections, e.g. better progression tiers, by swapping the star system's definition, which these follow.

contractEmployers.description: The factions that can hire the company for the star system's generated contracts, without the employers the story sets aside, sorted by name, each with its targets; a contract's own requirements can narrow them, and story and flashpoint contracts name their own.

difficulty.description: The star system's difficulty, as the starmap shows it.

canTravelTo.description: Whether the star system's travel requirements are met; story star systems stay locked until then.

route.description: The trip from the current star system; `null` when the game finds no route, always when canTravelTo is false.

DefinitionReference.description: A game definition: its id from the game's data files and the name shown in the UI.

id.description: The definition's id from the game's data files, or its name in the game's enumeration where it has no data file (e.g. the player's faction).

ByStoreOfStringList.description: A value per store of a star system: its system store, faction store and black market.

system.description: The value for the system store.

faction.description: The value for the faction store.

blackMarket.description: The value for the black market.

ContractEmployer.description: A faction that offers contracts in a star system, with the factions they can be against.

employer.description: The faction that offers the contracts.

targets.description: The factions it can hire the company against there, sorted by name: its enemies among the star system's targets, except the company's allies and the targets the story sets aside.

Route.description: The trip from the current star system, as the starmap plans and shows it.

days.description: The days the trip takes from the current star system's planet, with the whole leg to its jump point (game-state.json position.travel.jumpPointDays) even during a trip, which game-state.json position.travel.legEndsOnDay corrects; 0 for the current star system.

cost.description: The C-Bills the trip costs; 0 for the current star system.
